pages.text: Craft the $(bold)Prospector's Pick$() early. Right-click stone and it tells you what ore is nearby and roughly where. Walk, tap, walk, tap. It never breaks.$(br2)Geolosys hands you its own $(bold)Field Manual$() on first join — it lists every deposit, what it drops, and at what depth.

Metals you will need, in order: $(bold)copper and iron$() (homestead), $(bold)zinc$() (sphalerite — brass needs it, and brass needs a Blueprint), $(bold)gold, coal$() in bulk once machines run.$(br2)Mark deposits on your atlas. The first player to find zinc should tell everyone.
